_source: bsde/docs/UCE_AND_THE_THREE_CHALLENGES.md, investigator-briefed, VERBATIM. Do not edit the text of any `statement` field. There are THREE challenges. A fourth was invented by an earlier session and is recorded below as retired.

A.statement: predicts loss and recovery across anaesthetics while MINIMISING drug-identification information
acceptance_has_two_halves: HALF 1: the candidate tracks LOSS AND RECOVERY of consciousness -- transitions, not dose-response -- and does so ACROSS different anaesthetic agents
HALF 2: the candidate carries as LITTLE drug-identity information as possible
A.statistic: E05's S: positive when a candidate follows behavioural STATE, negative when it follows the DRUG
A.not_this: characterising how measures DIFFER between agents. That is the quantity half 2 asks to be MINIMISED, so a large between-agent difference disqualifies a candidate rather than constituting a finding.

acceptance_has_two_halves: HALF 1: the EEG is SPONTANEOUS -- task-free, not recorded during the command-following paradigm itself
HALF 2: the outcome is COMMAND-FOLLOWING, the covert-consciousness construct, not BCI aptitude in healthy volunteers
B.incumbent_note: rule 86 -- the incumbent must not share a measurement act with the outcome
B.not_this: BCI performance prediction in healthy subjects, which is a proxy whose transfer to command-following has never been justified.

C.statement: seeing a transition before the conventional monitor
acceptance_has_two_halves: HALF 1: a TRANSITION, resolved in time -- earlier detection, not better discrimination at a timepoint
HALF 2: BEFORE THE CONVENTIONAL MONITOR -- the comparator is the deployed monitor (BIS), not a computed spectral-edge proxy
C.known_defect_in_prior_verdicts: E26, E34 and E37 all scored against SEF95, a computed proxy, because BIS is absent from DOSE-I. VitalDB records BIS. Those negatives do not refute the claim they appear to refute.
C.not_this: discriminating depth or stage at a timepoint, however well.

_retired.D: NOT A BRIEFED CHALLENGE. Invented by an earlier session as a transport prediction; zero hits for 'Challenge D' in RESEARCH_PROGRAM_BRIEF.md and UCE_AND_THE_THREE_CHALLENGES.md. Work filed under D is not work on the programme's goals. Retired 2026-08-02.
